svg.title: Fabric-A: the design and the devices Generators create from it
svg.desc: In Infrahub, the NetworkFabric Fabric-A contains the NetworkPods Pod-A1 to Pod-A3, which reference the LocationRacks Rack-A2-1 to Rack-A3-4. Fabric-A sets 6 super spines, each pod 4 spines, except Pod-A1, which has the role fabric, and each rack 1 or 2 leaf switches. When you run the Generators, the Fabric Generator creates 6 super spines, the Pod Generator creates 8 spines and the Rack Generator creates 11 leaf switches in the 8 racks, connected as a fabric.

g.text: Created when you run the Generators
